description: Fleet-wide vocabulary of experience capabilities, capture axes, evidence kinds, and perceivable states. Referenced by react-component-library catalog assets through requiredCapabilities and expects, and by scenario experience specs through claim scoping. No document here records status: whether a capability is provable is computed from the live reconciler.

documents.title: Canonical perceivable-state vocabulary and consumer views
Perception — appearance, contrast, geometry, and craft floors
Interaction — pointer, keyboard, focus, and dismissal
Responsive — viewport, orientation, and reflow behavior
Accessibility — semantics, naming, structure, and announcement
Motion — transition classes, timing, and reduced-motion policy
Resilience — offline, stale, partial, failed, and recovering states
Craft — detail work capped below machine tier by design
